# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")

  # Strip backticks and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\u2013", "-", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("---", " - ", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("--", "-", text, fixed = TRUE)

  # Protect existing LaTeX commands before escaping special characters
  cmd_vault <- character(0)
  stash_cmd <- function(m) {
    idx <- length(cmd_vault) + 1L
    cmd_vault[[idx]] <<- m
    paste0("@@LTXCMD", idx, "@@")
  }
  m_cmd <- gregexpr("\\\\[a-zA-Z]+(\\{[^{}]*\\})*", text, perl = TRUE)
  if (m_cmd[[1]][1] != -1) {
    matched <- regmatches(text, m_cmd)[[1]]
    repl <- vapply(matched, stash_cmd, character(1))
    regmatches(text, m_cmd) <- list(repl)
  }

  # Convert Markdown bold/italic syntax inside cells/captions to LaTeX equivalents
  text <- gsub("\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*", "\\\\textbf{\\1}", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("\\*([^*]+)\\*", "\\\\textit{\\1}", text, perl = TRUE)

  # Re-stash newly generated \textbf / \textit commands so their braces are preserved
  m_cmd2 <- gregexpr("\\\\(textbf|textit)\\{[^{}]*\\}", text, perl = TRUE)
  if (m_cmd2[[1]][1] != -1) {
    matched2 <- regmatches(text, m_cmd2)[[1]]
    repl2 <- vapply(matched2, stash_cmd, character(1))
    regmatches(text, m_cmd2) <- list(repl2)
  }

  # Escape raw LaTeX special characters
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)#", "\\\\#", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", text, perl = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", text, perl = TRUE)

  # Replace Unicode Greek, mathematical, and typographic symbols with valid LaTeX commands
  unicode_map <- list(
    c("\u00b1", "\\ensuremath{\\pm}"),
    c("\u00d7", "\\ensuremath{\\times}"),
    c("\u00b0", "\\ensuremath{^{\\circ}}"),
    c("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}"),
    c("\u00b3", "\\textsuperscript{3}"),
    c("\u2248", "\\ensuremath{\\approx}"),
    c("\u2264", "\\ensuremath{\\le}"),
    c("\u2265", "\\ensuremath{\\ge}"),
    c("\u2260", "\\ensuremath{\\neq}"),
    c("\u2192", "\\ensuremath{\\rightarrow}"),
    c("\u2190", "\\ensuremath{\\leftarrow}"),
    c("\u2194", "\\ensuremath{\\leftrightarrow}"),
    c("\u03b1", "\\ensuremath{\\alpha}"),
    c("\u03b2", "\\ensuremath{\\beta}"),
    c("\u03b3", "\\ensuremath{\\gamma}"),
    c("\u03b4", "\\ensuremath{\\delta}"),
    c("\u03b5", "\\ensuremath{\\varepsilon}"),
    c("\u03b8", "\\ensuremath{\\theta}"),
    c("\u03bb", "\\ensuremath{\\lambda}"),
    c("\u03bc", "\\ensuremath{\\mu}"),
    c("\u03c0", "\\ensuremath{\\pi}"),
    c("\u03c1", "\\ensuremath{\\rho}"),
    c("\u03c3", "\\ensuremath{\\sigma}"),
    c("\u03c4", "\\ensuremath{\\tau}"),
    c("\u03c6", "\\ensuremath{\\varphi}"),
    c("\u03c7", "\\ensuremath{\\chi}"),
    c("\u03c9", "\\ensuremath{\\omega}"),
    c("\u0394", "\\ensuremath{\\Delta}"),
    c("\u03a3", "\\ensuremath{\\Sigma}"),
    c("\u03a9", "\\ensuremath{\\Omega}")
  )
  for (pair in unicode_map) {
    text <- gsub(pair[1], pair[2], text, fixed = TRUE)
  }

  # Restore stashed LaTeX commands
  if (length(cmd_vault) > 0) {
    for (idx in rev(seq_along(cmd_vault))) {
      text <- gsub(paste0("@@LTXCMD", idx, "@@"), cmd_vault[[idx]], text, fixed = TRUE)
    }
  }

  return(text)
}

# Global knitr hook to sanitize Unicode math/Greek and dashes in prose while preserving code chunks
local({
   sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function(lines) {
    in_chunk <- FALSE
    in_yaml <- FALSE
    yaml_delim_count <- 0L
    unicode_prose_map <- list(
      c("\u2014", " - "),
      c("\u2013", "-"),
      c("\u00b1", "$\\\\pm$"),
      c("\u00d7", "$\\\\times$"),
      c("\u2248", "$\\\\approx$"),
      c("\u2264", "$\\\\le$"),
      c("\u2265", "$\\\\ge$"),
      c("\u2260", "$\\\\neq$"),
      c("\u2192", "$\\\\rightarrow$"),
      c("\u2190", "$\\\\leftarrow$"),
      c("\u2194", "$\\\\leftrightarrow$"),
      c("\u03b1", "$\\\\alpha$"),
      c("\u03b2", "$\\\\beta$"),
      c("\u03b3", "$\\\\gamma$"),
      c("\u03b4", "$\\\\delta$"),
      c("\u03b5", "$\\\\varepsilon$"),
      c("\u03b8", "$\\\\theta$"),
      c("\u03bb", "$\\\\lambda$"),
      c("\u03bc", "$\\\\mu$"),
      c("\u03c0", "$\\\\pi$"),
      c("\u03c1", "$\\\\rho$"),
      c("\u03c3", "$\\\\sigma$"),
      c("\u03c4", "$\\\\tau$"),
      c("\u03c6", "$\\\\varphi$"),
      c("\u03c7", "$\\\\chi$"),
      c("\u03c9", "$\\\\omega$"),
      c("\u0394", "$\\\\Delta$"),
      c("\u03a3", "$\\\\Sigma$"),
      c("\u03a9", "$\\\\Omega$")
    )
    for (i in seq_along(lines)) {
      line <- lines[i]
      if (grepl("^---\\s*$", line)) {
        yaml_delim_count <- yaml_delim_count + 1L
        in_yaml <- (yaml_delim_count == 1L)
        next
      }
      if (in_yaml) {
        line <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", line, fixed = TRUE)
        line <- gsub("\u2013", "-", line, fixed = TRUE)
        lines[i] <- line
        next
      }
      if (grepl("^```", line)) {
        in_chunk <- !in_chunk
        next
      }
      if (!in_chunk) {
        for (pair in unicode_prose_map) {
          line <- gsub(pair[1], pair[2], line, fixed = TRUE)
        }
        lines[i] <- line
      }
    }
    lines
  }

  rmd_input <- knitr::current_input()
  if (!is.null(rmd_input) && nzchar(rmd_input) && file.exists(rmd_input)) {
    raw_lines <- readLines(rmd_input, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
    clean_lines <- sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex(raw_lines)
    if (!identical(raw_lines, clean_lines)) {
      writeLines(clean_lines, rmd_input, useBytes = TRUE)
    }
  }
})
```

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "polotsk_turov_and_belarusian_principalities_settlements.json"
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}

last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  clean_vec <- gsub("\u2116", "No.", clean_vec)
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) return("-")
  out <- paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; ")
  if (nchar(out) > 48L) out <- paste0(substr(out, 1L, 45L), "...")
  return(out)
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])
  fmt_deg <- function (val) {
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(val)))
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(s)
  }
  lat_s <- paste0(fmt_deg(lat), if (lat >= 0) "°N" else "°S")
  lon_s <- paste0(fmt_deg(lon), if (lon >= 0) "°E" else "°W")
  return(paste0(lat_s, ", ", lon_s))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  ord <- order(yrs)
  yrs <- yrs[ord]
  vals <- vals[ord]
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  if (length(keep) > 5L) {
    sel_idx <- unique(round(seq(1, length(keep), length.out = 5L)))
    keep <- keep[sel_idx]
  }
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles population estimates for `r format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = ".")` excavated settlements across the 207,6k km² river basins of Polotsk, Turov and Belarusian Rus from the Final Palaeolithic (10000BC) to the early Grand Duchy of Lithuania (1400AD) [@shtykhov1992goroda; @zagorulsky2001arkheologiya; @lysenko2004drevniy]. The prehistoric and Iron Age series cover 24 representative sites, including the mammoth- and reindeer-hunter camps of Yurevichi and Berdizh (40 - 65 inhabitants in 10000BC), the waterlogged Neolithic pile dwellings of the Krivina peat basin at Asavets (160 - 340 inhabitants in 2500BC), the Milograd, Zarubintsy and Brushed Pottery hillforts (320 - 560 inhabitants in 500BC - 200AD) and the tenth-century craft complex on the Menka river (2,4k in 1000AD) [@charniauski1997arkhealogiya; @isaenko1999arkhealogiya; @zagorulsky1982vozniknovenie].

Across the medieval fortified towns (*gorodishcha*) and rural settlements occupied between 800AD and 1400AD, urban populations reached their pre-Mongol peak in 1200AD under the Izyaslavichi princes of Polotsk and the Rurikid rulers of Turov-Pinsk and Black Ruthenia, led by Polotsk (25k across 190 ha), Turov (12k), Vitebsk (9,5k), Minsk (9k), Grodno (8,5k), Pinsk (8k), Berestye (7,5k), Novogrudok (7,5k) and Gomel (6,5k) [@tarasov1998polotsk; @lysenko1985berestye; @gurevich1981drevniy]. While Batu Khan's columns of 1239-1241AD sacked Gomel (falling to 3,5k in 1250AD), Turov (7k), Mozyr (2,1k) and Berestye (5,2k) along the southern frontier, the northern and western capitals of Polotsk (22k in 1250AD, 23k in 1400AD), Vitebsk (9,5k in 1400AD), Minsk (8,8k), Grodno (8,5k) and Novogrudok (rising to 9k in 1300AD as Mindaugas's early seat) escaped destruction and anchored the early Lithuanian-Ruthenian realm.

# Methodology

Across the 207,6k km² river basins of Polotsk, Turov and Belarusian Rus, archaeological excavations and chronicle records document `r format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = ".")` principal settlements between the Final Palaeolithic (10000BC), the Mongol campaigns of 1238-1241 and the late thirteenth-century principalities (1240AD - 1400AD) [@shtykhov1992goroda; @zagorulsky2001arkheologiya; @lysenko2004drevniy].

# Results

## Summary by Chronological Horizon

```{r tab-epoch-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cnt_prehist <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) <= -1000, logical(1)))
cnt_classic <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > -1000 && first_year_num(s) <= 400, logical(1)))
cnt_med     <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 && first_year_num(s) <= 1240, logical(1)))
cnt_late    <- sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 1240 && first_year_num(s) <= 1400, logical(1)))

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Horizon = c(
    "I. Palaeolithic, Neolithic, Trypillia and Bronze Age (10000BC - 1000BC)",
    "II. Early Iron Age, Scythian, Roman-Era and Antiquity (999BC - 400AD)",
    "III. Early Slavonic and Pre-Mongol Kievan Rus (401AD - 1240AD)",
    "IV. Post-Mongol Appanage and Early Lithuanian Transition (1241AD - 1400AD)",
    "Total Gazetteer Settlements"
  ),
  First_Attested_Count = c(
    format(cnt_prehist, big.mark = "."),
    format(cnt_classic, big.mark = "."),
    format(cnt_med, big.mark = "."),
    format(cnt_late, big.mark = "."),
    format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = ".")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  summary_df,
  list(
    caption = paste0("Chronological distribution of the ", format(length(settlements_list), big.mark = "."), " catalogued settlements and archaeological habitation sites in ", "Polotsk, Turov and Belarusian Rus", " by horizon of earliest documented stratum (10000BC - 1400AD)."),
    col_names = c("Chronological Horizon", "Attested Sites"),
    label = "tab:epoch-summary",
    font_size = "footnotesize"
  )
)
```

## Prehistoric, Classical and Early Slavonic Habitation Sites

Table \ref{tab:prehistoric-classical} lists all `r format(sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 400, logical(1))), big.mark = ".")` settlements and excavated habitation sites first attested between 10000BC and 400AD, giving geographic coordinates, occupied spans and up to five representative benchmark population estimates.

```{r table-prehistoric-classical, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sub_ancient <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 400, settlements_list)
df_ancient <- data.frame(
  col_1 = vapply(sub_ancient, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  col_2 = vapply(sub_ancient, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  col_3 = vapply(sub_ancient, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  col_4 = vapply(sub_ancient, fmt_span, character(1)),
  col_5 = vapply(sub_ancient, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_ancient,
  list(
    caption = paste0("Prehistoric, Eneolithic, Bronze Age, Iron Age and Roman-era settlements founded between 10000BC and 400AD in ", "Polotsk, Turov and Belarusian Rus", " (", format(length(sub_ancient), big.mark = "."), " entries)."),
    label = "tab:prehistoric-classical",
    col_names = c("Settlement / Site", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "Span", "Selected Benchmarks"),
    font_size = "footnotesize",
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Medieval Rus, Appanage and Fourteenth-Century Centres

Table \ref{tab:medieval-towns} lists all `r format(sum(vapply(settlements_list, function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 || last_year_num(s) >= 500, logical(1))), big.mark = ".")` settlements active between 500AD and 1400AD, pairing archaeological hillforts and fortified principality capitals with post-1240AD continuation toward the fifteenth century.

```{r table-medieval-towns, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
sub_med <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) > 400 || last_year_num(s) >= 500, settlements_list)
df_med <- data.frame(
  col_1 = vapply(sub_med, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)),
  col_2 = vapply(sub_med, fmt_other_names, character(1)),
  col_3 = vapply(sub_med, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  col_4 = vapply(sub_med, fmt_span, character(1)),
  col_5 = vapply(sub_med, function (s) fmt_pop_series(s, 401, 1400), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = paste0("Medieval Rus, Golden Horde and Grand Duchy of Lithuania transition settlements active from 500AD to 1400AD in ", "Polotsk, Turov and Belarusian Rus", " (", format(length(sub_med), big.mark = "."), " entries)."),
    label = "tab:medieval-towns",
    col_names = c("Settlement / Site", "Alternative Names", "Coords", "Span", "Selected Benchmarks"),
    font_size = "footnotesize",
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    span_columns = TRUE
  )
)
```
